Pair Identity Details
Pair Identity Details

Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote and Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair are treated as a single 3★ Identity in the Extraction. Obtaining either Identity will always yield the other in the pair.

· The Extraction rates for Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote & Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair are as follows:
  - In Target Extractions where the pair is featured as the 3★ pickup: The same appearance rate as 1 featured 3★ Identity
  - In all other Extractions where the pair can appear: The same appearance rate as 1 non-featured 3★ Identity
(for detailed rates, please refer to [Probabilities] for each Extraction)

· Starlight is also calculated as if the pair were a single 3★ Identity. When first obtained through Extraction, the two Identities grant a combined total of 300 Starlight.

· In Target Extractions where both Identities are featured as the 3★ pickup, both can be exchanged together for 200 Yisang [Ideality].

· If the pair is obtained again after both Identities have already been acquired, you will receive 25 Don Quixote Egoshards and 25 Sinclair Egoshards from the current Season instead of the usual Egoshards awarded for duplicate Identities of their rarity.

· Once the pair is added to the Dispenser, both Identities can be obtained together for a combined total of 400 Don Quixote and Sinclair Egoshards. You must use at least 1 Egoshard from each Sinner, but you can adjust the ratio between the two freely.

· Identity level-ups, Upties, and Façade Projection must be performed separately for each Identity. Each Identity requires the same materials as a standard 3★ Identity. Any Egoshards required for these upgrades must belong to the respective Sinner.
